name: khelpcenter
description: KDE Help Center - headless Xapian documentation search stack (khcdocmetainfo library + khc_xapianindexer/khc_xapiansearch tools)

commands.name: khc_xapianindexer
commands.description: Build/update the Xapian full-text index out of the KDocTools documentation caches (*.cache.bz2)

commands.name: khc_xapiansearch
commands.description: Query a Xapian index and print the results as an HTML fragment (khelpcenter searchhandler protocol)
